title: Stuart DeCew (Yale CBEY Executive Director) — 'One of the best hours of listening to an author explore their work that I have ever experienced'
summary: Stuart DeCew — Executive Director and Lecturer at the Yale Center for Business and the Environment — attends Eric's Yale talk on Incorruptible and posts a substantive endorsement, calling it essential reading for early-stage climate tech founders and anyone building for long-term purpose. Cites Hugo & Hoby, Patagonia, Costco, Dr. Bronner's, and Cotopaxi as counterexamples that resonate with 18 years at Yale.
blockquote: I just got the chance to see Eric Ries speak about his new book Incorruptible. One of the best hours of listening to an author explore their work that I have ever experienced. Thought provoking, honest, and full of insight that was earned from challenging and testing his own beliefs and assumptions.
attribution_title: Executive Director & Lecturer, Yale Center for Business and the Environment (CBEY)
